card.family: science prize e c4 versus star39

task.name: Four-cycle-free graphs of large minimum degree (Ramsey number R(C4,K1,39))
task.family: science prize e c4 versus star39
task.description: construct() -> {'n': n, 'edges': [[u, v], ...]}: a simple graph on vertices 0..n-1 with 1 <= n <= 47, containing no C4, whose minimum degree is at least n - 39 (so the complement has no K1,39). Maximize n. A C4-free graph on n vertices with minimum degree at least n-39 certifies R(C4,K1,39) > n. The value is known to be 46 or 47, so 46 vertices would settle it.
